display.method: Original Driver-home approximation; game-rendered selected-build thumbnail. Speed/RPM/gear use actual telemetry. Unsimulated fields unavailable. At most10Hz changed-value upload, only nearby/front-facing/in-view; no rival displays.

recovery.policy: Fresh scored attempt at grid; no reward for abandoned attempt

entry.readyBoundary: First rendered ready menu and enabled start controls; firstDrivingTick is separate after user start/countdown
entry.method: Wall-clock stage boundaries and loading RAF intervals. Fetch timing includes cache behavior; load/decode phases overlap network as stated. Waiting is not CPU or GPU rendering cost.

design.stationConvention: Planar metres for projection, laps and gates; Y from the same sampled cross-sections. 3D arc length is reported separately.

brakingZones.description: Downhill linked return bends; 200/150/100/50 m boards

design.source: src/ridge/route.ts; original cubic plan and integrated cosine grade; no surveyed route
design.terrainSupport: One non-coincident physical road/shoulder/terrain ribbon to 60m on either side; farther scenic ridges visual only, no support floor

suspension.model: SM-3223 Silver (Standard), original approximation. Front carriers retained; rear vertical-raycast linkage approximation unchanged.

products.inspectionMethod: Only seats temporarily removed; original doors hinge open. Complete car visibility restored on exit.

input.directionHelp: Stop, release pedals, then press brake for reverse. Forward pedal brakes reverse; release and press again to drive. X/right face selects direction explicitly.

audio.captureBus: post-limiter master including engine, rivals, interface, door and Thermal
